description: 8-TC remote Ethernet I/O, Modbus/TCP. FC04: TC_multipliedEngineeringValue unit 0.1°C/°F or 0.0001mV hi/lo (addr 2048-2063), TC_scaledValue u32 hi/lo (2064-2079), TC_multipliedEngineeringValueMin hi/lo (2080-2095), TC_multipliedEngineeringValueMax hi/lo (2096-2111), TC_scaledValueMin (2112-2127), TC_scaledValueMax (2128-2143). FC01: TC_resetMinValue (4177-4184), TC_resetMaxValue (4185-4192), TC_CJC calibration start (4193-4200). FC03: TC_refEngValue float ch0-3 (addr 2144-2151), modelName (addr 5000, 10 words, R/W — NOTE: FC03 not FC04 for E1262).
